title: Folded Letter
central_conflict: a folded letter was found inside a book with half its address missing
decisive_choice: the paper's watermark named the town's original post office
resolution: asked the postmaster to trace the missing address and returned the letter
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a folded letter was found inside a book with half its address missing before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they guessed the destination, but the first delivery reached the wrong house; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the paper's watermark named the town's original post office; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they asked the postmaster to trace the missing address and returned the letter, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Bell-Shaped Ball
central_conflict: a hollow ball stopped making its cheerful ringing sound
decisive_choice: a loose seam revealed a small metal bead trapped in the lining
resolution: opened the seam carefully and restored the ringing bead before the games
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a hollow ball stopped making its cheerful ringing sound before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they shook it harder, but the rattle inside stayed completely still; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a loose seam revealed a small metal bead trapped in the lining; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they opened the seam carefully and restored the ringing bead before the games, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Thirsty Flower
central_conflict: a rare flower began drooping as its watering can ran dry
decisive_choice: a string could wick water slowly from the bucket into the dry soil
resolution: set up the simple wick and watched the flower recover by morning
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a rare flower began drooping as its watering can ran dry before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they carried a bucket uphill, but most water spilled over the rocky path; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a string could wick water slowly from the bucket into the dry soil; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they set up the simple wick and watched the flower recover by morning, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
